title: First Steps
description: Slide the Rook, become the Pawn, leap as the Knight, finish as the Bishop. One clear path.

title: The Chain
description: Start as a Rook and follow the chain. Two paths exist — find either one.

title: Two Roads
description: The Queen has two opening captures. One is a dead end. Choose wisely.

title: Knight's Leap
description: The Knight can jump two ways. One path leads nowhere — the other clears the board.

title: Royal Succession
description: Start as the King and climb the chain. The Queen opens two routes — both reach the end.
